ios.desc:
SayItRight: Your Personalized Pronunciation Coach

Unlock the power of effective communication with SayItRight, the app designed to help you improve your English pronunciation skills effortlessly. Whether you are a beginner or looking to refine your speech, SayItRight offers a comprehensive set of features tailored to your needs.

Key Features:

	• Interactive Practice Sessions: Choose from a library of engaging pre-made articles or create custom sessions. Each session allows you to read aloud and receive instant feedback on your pronunciation.
	• Real-Time Speech Recognition: Our advanced speech recognition technology listens as you speak, highlighting mispronounced words and providing detailed feedback to enhance your skills.
	• Progress Tracking: Monitor your growth with our intuitive dashboard, displaying your performance stats over different time frames—daily, weekly, and monthly. Discover which days you are most active and set goals to stay on track.
	• Personalized Difficulty Levels: Adjust the sensitivity of speech recognition to match your skill level. With options for Easy, Medium, and Hard, SayItRight adapts to your learning pace, ensuring an optimal practice experience.
	• Audio Playback: Listen to your recordings after each session to evaluate your progress and identify areas for improvement. The app allows you to compare your pronunciation with the correct version effortlessly.
	• Share Your Achievements: Showcase your progress and achievements by sharing your stats with friends, motivating yourself and others on the journey to better pronunciation.
	• User-Friendly Interface: Enjoy a sleek and intuitive design that makes practicing pronunciation engaging and straightforward.

With SayItRight, mastering English pronunciation is just a tap away. Join a community of learners and start your journey to confident speaking today!

show_hn.title: Show HN: I made an app that helps non-native speakers sound confident in English

quotes.text:
I’m a solo developer and I built SayItRight to solve something that’s quietly held a lot of people back, including me and many friends: feeling self-conscious about how we speak English.

Most non-native speakers I know are great at writing English. We read docs, chat on Slack, write emails, no problem. But when it comes to speaking out loud, especially in meetings, interviews, or even casual conversations ~ it’s a different story. You overthink your pronunciation, wonder if you sound weird, or get asked to repeat yourself. AUGHH! It’s frustrating.

SayItRight is a small app that helps you get better at that. It’s not flashy. It doesn’t use GPT or anything like that. I just wanted something fast, focused, and useful. Think of it like practicing scales on a guitar .. simple reps, but they build fluency.

I’d love to hear what you think. If this is something you’ve struggled with, or if you’ve found other ways to get better, I’m all ears.
